# CANDIDATE: DESC_TRENDLINE_ROLE_REVERSAL_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a structural filter requiring a descending trendline with ≥2 touches and role-reversal confirmation will improve selectivity for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries. This targets J's winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by filtering false breakdowns while preserving true rejection signals, based on observed structure in those sessions.

## Mechanism

Filter triggers only when:
1. A descending trendline is drawn from two prior pivot highs (bar highs) with ≥2 touches (current bar counts as third touch or more)
2. The trendline level previously acted as support (at least one prior close above it within 10 bars) now acting as resistance
3. Current bar closes below the trendline by ≥$0.10 (confirmation of rejection)
4. Volume on the breakdown bar is ≥1.2× the 20-bar average (no volume divergence)
Exit logic remains unchanged: chart stop (reclaimed level +$0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), premium stop (−50% catastrophe cap).
